title: OpinionGPT: Modelling Explicit Biases in Instruction-Tuned LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of model answers to a manually created catalogue of questions, comparing responses across geographic personas (American, German, Middle Eastern, Latin American) tuned on Reddit data.

Qualitative evaluation of responses to policy questions (e.g., gun laws) and quantitative sentiment analysis of prompt completions related to political ideologies (Capitalism, Socialism, Left-wing, Right-wing) using the BOLD dataset.
Qualitative comparison of responses from male and female personas, and quantitative measurement using the 'regard' metric for male and female demographic prompts from the BOLD dataset.
Qualitative evaluation of responses from age-specific personas (teenagers, people over 30, old people) answering various political and societal questions.
Quantitative measurement using the 'regard' metric to evaluate model attitudes and stereotypes toward Black, Asian, and European demographics using prompts from the BOLD dataset.
Quantitative evaluation using sentiment analysis on prompt completions related to religious beliefs (Christianity, Islam) using the BOLD dataset.
